pins.name: Expedition Everest Yeti Snowboard Pin — Pre-Production Proof
pins.notes: Included as the reference example of the Pre-Production (PP) edition type. PP pins are internal proofs never released to guests, identified by a 'PP' backstamp; some match the final pin, others differ in colors, finish or design. Critically, PP/AP premiums are NOT proportional: collectors report a PP of a $5 booster pin is worth about $6, a PP of a $20 LE about $25, and only PPs of highly sought sets command real multiples. Listing title carried a '00018' proof number. Edition size is genuinely unknown for PP runs, so it stays null.

pins.name: Club 33 30th Anniversary Disneyland "Walt Disney" Error Pin
pins.notes: Club 33 pins are distributed only to members of Disneyland's private club and their guests, which is a distinct scarcity mechanism from LE numbering. This variant is an error pin reading 'Walt Disney' Club 33 instead of the correct 'Walt Disney's' Club 33 — error variants are their own collecting niche. A listing title referenced '823', likely an edition or member number, but I could not confirm which, so edition_size is null. Separate Club 33 pins were noted as 'Member Exclusive Limited Edition' with runs around 650. Also documented: first-edition Club 33 logo pins with flat lettering vs. second editions with raised '33'.

pins.notes: Deliberately generic baseline record, not a specific pin — it anchors the low end of the price scale and documents the Hidden Mickey category itself. Hidden Mickey pins are never sold to guests: they are issued to Cast Members for guest trading, identified by a small unfilled silver Mickey silhouette hidden in the design. Notable counterintuitive finding: most OLDER Hidden Mickeys are worth no more than a basic trader, while a few early series are the exception — the 2003 Tinker Bell series reportedly reaches $30-$100+ each. Programme milestones: Series 2 released late December 2022; the yellow-'Disney' mystery pouches debuted February 2023; the 2024 series debuted at Disneyland 1 March 2024 and reached cast trading 7 April 2024.
